title: Strategy (MSTR) Shareholders Approve Daily Dividends on Four Preferred Stocks
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy (MSTR) Shareholders Approve Daily Dividends on Four Preferred Stocks Strategy (MSTR) shareholders approved paying daily dividends on four of its preferred stocks.
